featured_reviews.review_text:
*1/5 Stars*

I'm extremely disappointed with my experience at GPM College in Andheri. The infrastructure is outdated, and the classrooms are not well-maintained. The faculty seems uninterested in teaching, and the curriculum is not industry-relevant.

The administration is also very uncooperative, and it's difficult to get any work done. The college lacks extracurricular activities, and there are no opportunities for students to develop their skills outside of academics.

The placement cell is also ineffective, and most students have to look for jobs on their own. Overall, I would not recommend GPM College to anyone.

*Pros:* None

*Cons:* Poor infrastructure, uninterested faculty, uncooperative administration, lack of extracurricular activities, ineffective placement cell.

featured_reviews.name: Chetan Niphadkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently was part of the IEEE Techithon 2026 event organized by Atharva University Mumbai at Malad Campus from 28th to 30th January 2026. There was participation from different colleges from across country and students displayed their projects in form of proto types and applications which addressed some of the social causes as well. Use of Robotics, AI and Satellite communication initiatives were demonstrated by students which really were an inspiration for all generations. Founder Shri Sunil Rane Sir, was actively participating at the event and encouraging these young minds and lifting their morale to motivate them to make in India and also fund their projects and aspirations through Atharva University Mumbai's incubation Centre. Atharva University Mumbai has a state of art Campus with latest technology infrastructure to enable students to take up research and development of new projects and initiatives under the guidance of Shri Sunil Rane Sir and team of competent Engineering and Technology faculty members who along with the students made this event a grand success. Wishing all the young minds all the best wishes and Congratulations to Atharva University Mumbai for hosting this successful event. Jai Hind.

featured_reviews.name: Rita Pal
featured_reviews.review_text: The IEEE TECHITHON 26 organized at Atharva University, Mumbai was a well-structured and professionally conducted technical event. It effectively provided students with an opportunity to apply theoretical knowledge to practical problem-solving while fostering innovation and teamwork. The systematic organization and academic guidance contributed significantly to the success of the event. Overall, the initiative reflects the university’s commitment to academic excellence and technical skill development.

featured_reviews.name: Tanmay

The college also conducts technical events, workshops, and placement training sessions that help students improve their practical knowledge and career opportunities. Although attendance and academic rules are a bit strict, the overall environment is positive and motivating for students who want to grow academically and professionally.

featured_reviews.name: Shriya Salunkhe
featured_reviews.review_text:

The emphasis on practical learning, innovation, and emerging technologies helps students stay future-ready. Faculty members are supportive and encourage hands-on learning through projects and real-world applications.

The IEEE Techithon 2026 at Atharva University, held from 28–30 January 2026, was an exciting, well-organized technical fest and project exhibition. The three-day event featured enthusiastic participation from students and tech enthusiasts with activities like hackathons, robotics showcases, drone demonstrations, and innovative project exhibitions. Workshops and sessions highlighted emerging technologies and provided great learning opportunities.

featured_reviews.review_text: Wilson College was my HSC exam centre, so this is more from a visitor’s perspective than a student’s. The campus itself feels decent and functional, and the mess seemed okay for a quick meal. That said, some infrastructure could definitely use improvement…the benches in exam rooms felt oddly shaped and a bit worn out, and the washrooms were quite small with noticeable odor and heavy graffiti, which takes away from the overall experience. One clear highlight though is the location…the building facing the road has a really nice view right across Girgaon Chowpatty, which is hard to beat. Overall, it’s a mixed experience with a great location but room for better upkeep.

featured_reviews.name: Varun Singh (Map_Nomad)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wilson College is a timeless gem nestled along Mumbai’s iconic Girgaon Chowpatty.  The moment you step onto campus, you're greeted by stunning Gothic architecture—arched verandahs, teakwood trusses, and mosaic tile flooring that reflect its 19th-century heritage.  The classrooms, with their deep verandahs, offer breathtaking views of the Arabian Sea, making every lecture feel like a serene escape.

The college's library is a highlight, featuring
teakwood mezzanines and catwalks that exude old-world charm.  The assembly hall, adorned with stained glass and ornate balconies, adds to the campus's grandeur.  Beyond its aesthetics, Wilson College fosters a vibrant community spirit, especially evident during events like the POLARIS intercollege fest.

owner_posts.post_text: Another milestone. Another moment of gratitude. With the year gaining momentum, we remain committed to challenging norms, embracing innovation, and shaping a future-forward approach to design and media education. We are proud to share that we have been recognised with the Excellence in Design & Media Education Award by the Global Triumph Foundation. 🏆 This recognition stands as a testament to what we strongly believe - education today must go beyond classrooms, focusing on real-world exposure, industry relevance, and hands-on learning. At the heart of this achievement are our students - their trust, ambition, and growth inspire us to continuously raise the bar. Alongside them, our industry and placement partners, and our dedicated team, play a crucial role in bridging the gap between learning and real-world success. Each recognition strengthens our vision - to build an ecosystem where creativity is nurtured, skills are sharpened, and opportunities are limitless. The journey continues, with many more milestones ahead. When passion is guided with purpose, excellence follows.

A year guided by Gratitude, Growth and Recognition!

As 2026 unfolds, we continue to engage in dialogues that challenge convention, celebrate innovation, and redefine the future of creative education.

We had the privilege of being part of an esteemed Panel Discussion alongside dignitaries from leading educational institutions and colleges, where we engaged in a thought-provoking dialogue on
“What Should a 21st-Century Degree Look Like?”
The discussion reaffirmed a shared belief — that education today must go beyond conventional boundaries, focusing on real skills, industry relevance, and experiential learning.

Adding to this momentum, we are humbled and proud to be recognised as the Best Design & Media Institute 2025. This achievement belongs to our students first — their trust, feedback, and success stories continue to motivate us to raise the bar every day.

Our ability to deliver high-end practical exposure is strengthened by the selfless support of our industry partners, placement partners, and a dedicated internal team, who collectively help bridge the gap between education and real-world practice.

A heartfelt thank you to Academic Insights International (AIM) for recognizing our expertise and contribution to creative education. We look forward to continuing this journey of excellence, innovation, and impactful collaborations in the fields of Design & Media.

Many more milestones and meaningful partnerships await.

“When passion meets purpose, excellence follows"

featured_reviews.name: Niranjan Badle
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a formal complaint regarding the extremely poor and unprofessional support experienced during my spouse’s Online MBA program at NMIMS.
During the admission phase, the assigned counselor (Amita) was highly persistent in calling and following up for enrollment and fee payment. However, immediately after the payment of substantial fees, the level of support dropped significantly.
A critical issue arose when the exam registration link was not functioning. When we contacted the counselor for assistance, instead of providing guidance, she responded in an inappropriate and dismissive manner, stating:
"Main kyun aapko bataun? Aap kabhi mera phone uthate ho kya?"
Such a response is unacceptable and raises serious concerns about the professionalism and accountability expected from an institution of this stature.
To clarify:
• Students are not obligated to respond to repeated follow-up calls.
• However, once enrolled and fees are paid, it is the institution’s responsibility to ensure proper academic support and guidance.
• Denying or delaying support on personal grounds is highly unprofessional.
This experience reflects a concerning gap between the admission process and post-admission student support.
I urge NMIMS to:
Review the conduct of its counseling staff
Establish accountability in student support systems
Ensure that students receive timely and respectful assistance
If such issues are not addressed, it can significantly impact the trust and credibility of the institution.

featured_reviews.review_text:
MBA healthcare management
I thought pursuing an MBA from here would be a great decision, but unfortunately, it turned out to be one of the worst experiences.
The college promises placements, but the reality is very different. I was placed in a startup, and within just 3 months, the company shut down. The organization itself lacked experienced professionals and proper structure.
It has now been a year, and I am still searching for a stable job. Several of my batchmates are also still unemployed and did not receive any placement support. When we reached out to the college, they simply told us to find jobs on our own.
I pursued Healthcare Management, but the placement support and career guidance were extremely disappointing.
